notes:
v2.4.0: attack feats

These run only without Midi-QoL, under the Attack Rules setting. That's the same setting as before, renamed from "Advantage & Disadvantage on Attacks", so if you had it on it stays on.

  • Spell Sniper and Sharpshooter ignore cover.
    • Spell Sniper covers spell attacks (2014: ranged spell attacks only).
    • Sharpshooter covers ranged weapon attacks.
    • Both ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover: the cover bonus is taken off the target's AC on the attack card, so hit or miss is judged without it. Total Cover still blocks.
  • Spell Sniper range: doubled (2014) or +60 ft (2024) when the module checks range. With Automated Conditions 5e (AC5E) checking range, AC5E handles it.
  • Gunner: no disadvantage on any ranged attack with an enemy within 5 ft. AC5E doesn't know this feat, so the module takes its disadvantage back.
  • Crossbow Expert (2024):
    • The 5-ft exemption applies to crossbows only. AC5E exempts every ranged attack, so the module puts the disadvantage back for other weapons.
    • An off-hand hand crossbow attack adds your ability modifier to its damage.
  • On the card: an "Ignored" note shows what a feat let the attack ignore, e.g. "Goblin's cover (Spell Sniper)".
